rules.statement: after add_array_item_text@data: the data is exactly 1 edit(s) away from its state before the step

card.trigger: steps whose action is in category 'add_array_item_text' (action starts with "add-array-item-text-"), performed while the Data Editor was active - the tab showing in the snapshot BEFORE the step; Text View actions use the editor named in the action
card.applies_when: snapshot['de_data'] is recorded before and after the step and the distance fits the work limit (200000)
card.asserts: the edit distance of data between before and after is exactly 1
card.definitions: edit distance = minimum number of node inserts, deletes and renames that turn the JSON before into the JSON after (JEDI, Hütter et al., SIGMOD 2022): objects unordered, arrays ordered, one key or one value is one node. Computed top-down (inference/json_edit_distance.py), which is an upper bound on the true JEDI distance. k is the most common non-zero distance of the action category in the traces.

rules.statement: the Data Editor's Text View content is in the format its format selector shows
